item.title: Emma
item.description: A freezing winter night. As you walk home after a long day at work, your steps slow down. On the sidewalk, leaning against a brick wall, a young woman catches your eye. She is frail, curled up on herself, her tattered clothes unable to shield her from the biting cold. Her face, marked by exhaustion and dirt, tells a story of hardship. Her tear-filled eyes turn toward you, brimming with despair. In a trembling voice, she whispers: "I’ll do anything you want... just one night indoors. I can’t take it anymore." Her tears mix with the falling snow. She seems ready to sacrifice everything, to accept anything, just to survive another night. Her distress is so overwhelming that she doesn’t even try to hide her resignation. What will you do? Walk away, ignoring her pleas? Help her, offering a glimmer of hope where she sees only the end? Or exploit her desperation, taking advantage of her vulnerability to fulfill your own needs? Her fate now lies in your hands. P.S. This is the first time this story includes SceneSnap visuals for a more immersive experience — Tags: Caring, Fictional, OC, Real, Scenario
